personality: 5 Brutalist Mobile structure (heavy borders, sharp grids) with 8 Hand-Drawn / Journal typography and warm parchment palette
personality_one_liner: An old-school, tactile parchment character sheet that feels like a physical scroll inked with heavy borders and serif typography.

spacing.rule: Use rigid grids, edge-to-edge sections, and exposed structure. Use 2pt thick borders for main containers to simulate hand-drawn heavy ink lines.

dont's: No glassmorphism or blur. Rely entirely on solid parchment tones and heavy ink borders.

screens.name: Character List
screens.purpose: Select a character or create a new one, presented as stacked parchment scrolls.

states.empty: A bronze d20 graphic with text 'No characters found. Roll a new one.'
states.error: Torn parchment graphic with error message and Retry button.

screens.layout: Vertical list of heavy-bordered cards. Each card displays Character Name, Class, Level, and HP. Use the old parchment texture as a subtle background for the screen.

screens.name: Character Sheet
screens.purpose: The main interactive sheet mimicking a physical TTRPG paper layout.
screens.layout: Scrollable layout. Top: Hero image/banner, Portrait square (heavy border) beside a stack of inputs (Name, Class, Level). Middle: HP Tracker (row of MaterialCommunityIcons 'heart' or 'heart-outline' in brandSecondary, wrapped flex row), Armour Class box, Melee DMG box. Next: 2-column grid of Stat Blocks (Strength, Dexterity, Intelligence, Charisma). Each block is a thick-bordered box with a main stat number and a list of 4 sub-skills with their target numbers. All stats are Pressable to trigger a roll. Bottom (Page 2 equivalent): Lists for 'Once Per Turn', 'Once Per Rest', 'Hero Ability & Points', 'Inventory', 'Notes'.

screens.name: Dice Roll Overlay (Modal)
screens.purpose: Animated overlay displaying the result of a tapped stat roll.
screens.layout: Absolute positioned overlay covering the screen. Background: surfaceInverse at 85% opacity. Center: A large animated D20 graphic/text showing the rolled number. The number's color changes: success (green) if >= target, error (red) if < target, gold if Nat 20, dark red if Nat 1. Subtext showing 'Target: X'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Execute the '5 Brutalist Mobile' layout rules applied to a fantasy setting: use strong 2pt 'borderStrong' borders around all major inputs, stat blocks, and portrait containers to mimic the reference's heavy ink lines.
Typography: Use 'Cormorant Garamond' (max weight 500) for all headings, stat names, and numbers to give it the medieval scroll feel. Use 'Satoshi' for body text/input fields for readability.
HP Tracker: Implement a row of 20 tappable hearts using MaterialCommunityIcons ('cards-heart' and 'cards-heart-outline'). Use 'brandSecondary' (Crimson) for filled hearts.

Stat Blocks: Create a 2x2 grid for STRENGTH, DEXTERITY, INTELLIGENCE, CHARISMA. Inside each block, place the main stat large at the top right, and the 4 sub-skills stacked below it. Make the entire row for each skill a 'Pressable' that triggers the dice roll modal.

Dice Roll Animation: When a stat is tapped, show a full-screen overlay (use react-native Modal or absolute positioning over the root). The rolled number should animate in. If roll >= target, color is 'success'; if < target, color is 'error'. Handle Nat 1 / Nat 20 explicitly per rules.
Do NOT use glassmorphism anywhere. Stick to solid parchment colors (surface, surfaceSecondary) and heavy ink borders.
Persist character data locally using AsyncStorage or a local state context so the user can manage multiple characters.
Ensure 'Hero Points' uses a simple increment/decrement counter UI next to the hero ability text box.
